fixes.change: Catch LLM errors in extract; synthesize an evidence-only brief (confirmed sources by step, gaps, 'AI summary unavailable' label); mark run done+degraded instead of failed.
Fallback must not merge on anchor substring (cap 0.6); merge only on hard cross-links, URL or IČO match; drop or group non-profile web hits; dedupe by host+path.
No name-search results attributed to subject without a merged handle: skip with truthful gap or emit as lineup candidates; extract only SERP + merged-candidate sources, never possibly-same-as.
Budget skip and 'nothing to request' record 'not searched: <reason>' instead of the onEmpty 'no X found' text; brief separates searched-empty from not-searched.

Count only paid actor calls toward RUN_BUDGET_CALLS; free REST fetches currently exhaust the 12-call cap and silently skip website crawl and talks search. Add a test that the full hiring recipe reaches talks_serp.
Ask questions only about profile platforms, highest value first (LinkedIn, X, GitHub); platform marks instead of initials; show one-line match reason per row.
Expose failure {step, reason} from the ledger; keep progress rows with the failed row marked, plain-words reason, sources found so far, and a Try again action.
Row 1 'Searching public sources' until mentions>0; bar advances per collector step; remove false 'we will let you know'; 'Thanks, continuing' after answers; check res.ok in sendAnswer.
Run post-resolve collectors concurrently (Promise.all over step.do, batches of 4-6); sequential collectors alone take ~3 min and break the 2-4 minute promise.

Remove NEXT_PUBLIC_RUN_TOKEN (server-side token attach); distinct 400/401/429/503 messages; privacy copy 'deleted after 30 days' backed by a scheduled purge of expired sources (D1+R2); drop the dev footer.
